purpose: Correct the failed shared structural-node readout using the exact sealed V1 cache: normalized geometry regression and a separate place-association embedding, before any longer training.

sampling.rule: Consume the sealed V1 cache and manifest without regenerating or selecting rows: 18 C01 c1_mixed observations and 10 physical nodes in each of the ten independent S01-S10 topology parents.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Project-generated research assets; upstream redistribution conditions remain unchanged.

teacher.source: The unchanged 44-D construction-program structural descriptor and degree supervise geometry; node identity only constructs association pairs and never enters forward inputs.
teacher.valid_mask: All 180 sealed rows have a valid five-frame causal observation and at least one incident primitive port.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph run. Association proposes candidates only; the previously passed fixed 16 m graph-consistency test remains mandatory before any merge.
teacher.student_inputs: Only sealed endpoint geometry features and confidence derived by the frozen causal-LiDAR primitive backbone.

split.fit: The exact same 180 C01 observations are optimized and evaluated for memorization readiness only.
split.strict_test: C08-C10 and M-TARE read count is zero.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 failure changes only the readout factorization; sample rows, targets, update count and gates are unchanged, and no C07/C08 result selects parameters.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.optimization: Exactly 500 full-batch dual-readout-only AdamW updates; cosine learning rate 0.002 to 0.00002, weight decay 0, no backbone forward/update.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.loss: Analytic per-dimension geometry scaling only; final total loss reduction >=95% and raw geometry RMSE <=0.01.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.association: Independent normalized embedding, 1530 same-parent candidate pairs, tie-safe precision >=0.99 and recall >=0.95.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.system: All gradients finite, endpoint permutation invariance <=2e-6, repeated evaluation exact, sealed inputs unchanged, zero C07-C10/graph/M-TARE.

estimated_cost.compute: 500 full-batch updates on one cached 180-observation tensor

failure_policy: Any failure stops this student interface before one-seed training; do not add steps, regenerate data, inspect C07, lower gates or unfreeze the backbone.
retention: Keep checkpoint, metrics, diagnostic PNG/PDF/SVG, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal; retain V1 unchanged as a failed shared-readout ablation.

approval.scope: One immutable readout corrective on the sealed 180-observation cache with exactly 500 updates and zero C07-C10/graph/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly authorized continuous optimal in-scope execution without routine approval prompts; option A is the pre-registered V1 fallback.
